s.note: Smoked brisket, pickles and hot mustard on milk buns.
s.how: Warm the stock and barbecue sauce in a wide pan, add the brisket and heat through gently. Split and toast the buns. Mix the mustard and mayonnaise and spread it on the bases. Pile on the brisket and pickles, put the lids on and serve hot.

s.note: Seared tuna, ponzu, sesame and spring onion.
s.how: Stir the soy, lemon juice, rice vinegar and sugar together for the ponzu. Roll the tuna in the sesame seeds. Sear in the hot oil for 30 seconds a side so the middle stays raw, then rest a minute. Slice thinly with your sharpest knife and lay over the cucumber ribbons. Spoon over the ponzu and scatter with spring onion.
shop: 1 Lebanese cucumber, cut in thin ribbons@Produce

m.n: Miami benefit snapper with mango salsa
m.note: Crisp-skin snapper, mango salsa and coconut rice.
m.how: Rinse the rice and simmer it with the coconut milk, 200ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, until tender. Mix the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa. Score the fish skin, season and fry skin-side down in the hot oil until crisp, then flip for a minute. Serve the snapper on the rice with the salsa on top.

m.n: Herb Farmer's lake cabin beef pot pie
m.note: Slow beef, mushrooms and thyme under flaky pastry.
m.how: Toss the beef in seasoned flour and brown it in batches in the oil. Soften the onion and carrots, stir in the tomato paste, then return the beef with the stock and thyme. Cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart, adding the mushrooms for the last 30 minutes. Spoon into a pie dish, lay the pastry over, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

w.note: Molten dark chocolate, gold dust and cream.
w.how: Butter 4 moulds and dust them with cocoa. Melt the chocolate and butter together gently. Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the chocolate and flour. Fill the moulds and bake at 200C until set on top but still soft in the middle. Turn out, dust with gold and serve with the cream.
shop: 150g butter, plus extra for the moulds@Dairy

d.n: The bodyguard's orange juice, straight or not
d.note: Frank asks for orange juice on the job. Blood orange, vodka and soda over ice.
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour in the vodka and blood orange juice. Top with soda, stir once and add an orange slice.
